info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Discounts API enables businesses to retrieve discount information associated with retail orders. This endpoint allows users to access valuable insights into discounted items, helping them evaluate pricing strategies and customer promotions. Typical consumers include retail managers and pricing analysts who leverage this data to optimize sales and marketing efforts. The API enhances data-driven decision-making by providing a streamlined way to access and analyze discount data linked to retail transactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current available discounts that can be applied to customer orders. Use this to determine applicable discounts before placing an order.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving discount details on orders. Please provide the necessary details in JSON format according to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved available discounts for orders.
